card.name: Inside numbers before a comma or decimal
card.fires_on: Digits or thousands commas partway through a number, mostly in dose or trial-size figures and tables, where the number is still unfinished. It also fires on the end of a symptom term just before a closing bracket.

modes.label: Partway through numbers
modes.description: A digit or comma inside a longer number such as a patient count, dose or table value.

modes.label: Table of values
modes.description: A digit in a row of evenly spaced decimal numbers.

modes.label: End of a symptom word in brackets
modes.description: The last part of a side-effect word inside parentheses in a patient-information list.

card.plain: It marks a spot inside a number or term where a comma or separator is likely to follow soon.
